mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library tonight with a waxing crescent moon. It will be chilly with an overnight low of 31 degrees, but fortunately, there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released important notices regarding the upcoming November general election. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects, including a site plan and traffic analysis for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

We have a busy schedule! Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out the music at Wisconsin Brewing Company or the John Denver tribute at the High School Fine Arts Center. Looking ahead, don't miss trivia nights starting this Tuesday at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
In a report from October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a man passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
